name: Ensure Resource Group and its Resources are located in the same Region
description:
Ensure resource locations align with their resource group to manage resources during regional outages. ARM stores resource data, which if in an unavailable region, could halt updates, rendering resources read-only.
Learn more: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-resource-manager/management/overview#resource-group-location-alignment

name: If using single-instance VMs all OS and data disks must be Premium SSD or Ultra Disk
description:
For single-instance VMs, both OS and data disks must be either Premium SSD or Ultra Disk to achieve the single-instance SLA of 99.9% availability.
Learn more: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sap/workloads/planning-guide-storage
